title.zh: v2rayN 路由规则自定义与去广告分流方案：绕过局域网与大陆白名单极速优化
title.en: v2rayN Routing Rules & Ad-Blocking: Bypassing LAN & Domestic Whitelists for Peak Efficiency

description.zh: 详解 v2rayN 高级路由分流规则编写与去广告黑名单集成。教你如何配置【绕过大陆与局域网】智能路由模式、添加私有内网直连规则、拦截常见广告域名并定时自动更新 Geo 数据文件。
description.en: Complete guide to customizing v2rayN routing rules and ad-blocking domains. Learn how to configure Bypass Mainland China & LAN policies, manage private subnet rules, and automate GeoIP/GeoSite database updates.
